name: codemind-ai
description: Entorno de desarrollo web con documentacion asistida por IA (Groq). La IA explica; el usuario decide.

scripts.build: npm run gramaticas && npm --workspace web run build
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/pack-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.desktop:publicar: npm run build && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/pack-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish always && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.desktop:build:linux: npm run build && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/pack-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run build && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/pack-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
